basic_profile.bio: Hailing from the bustling city of Denver, I've been diving deep into the world of Reddit for just over a year now. As a 29-year-old software engineer, my love for all things sci-fi and fantasy often finds its way into my online interactions. I'm a huge fan of Adventure Time and enjoy the satirical humor of Babylon Bee. When I'm not coding or exploring the latest in tech, I like to unwind by watching baseball games or engaging in some tabletop RPGs with friends. Usually online in the evenings, I'm currently single and savoring the freedom to explore my diverse interests.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science, my expertise lies in software development and automation. I've always been a tinkerer at heart, teaching myself new programming languages and keeping up with the latest tech trends through various online courses and communities.
